title: Channel engagement prep — AWS/Azure/GCP weekly sync (Samir notes)
body:
Meeting context and purpose:
- Weekly alignment with cloud marketplace and channel partners (AWS, Azure, GCP + 2 resellers).
- Goal: unblock launch blockers, clarify next steps for listings, and get firm dates for co-marketing assets.

Participants to invite / confirm:
- AWS Partner BD: Priya Rao (ask on technical review status)
- Azure Marketplace PM: Tomasz Kowalski (billing integration question)
- GCP Marketplace Eng: Hannah Li (container image signing + review)
- Reseller ops: Marco (local deal desk contact)
- Internal: Ellen (partner success), Nico (legal on T&Cs), Samir (me)

Quick prep notes (what I will bring):
- Short deck (2 slides): one-slide status, one-slide blockers with recommended asks. Link to draft deck: /confluence/partner-decks/draft-march-2026 (referenced above).
- Metrics snapshot: last 30d hosted API token consumption by account tier, median P95 latency for marketplace workloads, allocation usage for Dedicated test pool. Pull query: analytics dashboard > marketplace/usage > last 30d.
- Open tickets to mention: JIRA-GTM-87 (docs copy for Azure listing), JIRA-ENG-1432 (container image signing CI job), JIRA-SEC-219 (KMS integration questions).

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
1) 3m quick intros + objectives
2) 5m launch timeline check (each party: go/no-go items)
3) 8m technical blockers deep-dive (image signing, billing contract id, SSO test accounts)
4) 7m co-marketing & assets (logos, one-pager approval, webinar date)
5) 4m next steps + owners + confirm weekly cadence

Key asks to surface per cloud partner:
- AWS: confirm final listing approval ETA and whether we can get a pre-approval sandbox listing for internal testing. Ask: can AWS partner team sign-off by 2026-03-24? Owner: Priya Rao.
- Azure: need explicit point of contact for offer ingestion and Microsoft CSP billing token. Ask: provide CSP contact and sample billing payload by 2026-03-18. Owner: Tomasz.
- GCP: container image signing check — GCP security asked for signed artifact and provenance proof. Ask: agree to a short window for staging testing (3 days) and provide test project id. Owner: Hannah Li.
- Resellers: confirm lead routing flow and minimum deal size for listing promotions. Owner: Marco Diaz.

Risks to call out (so we don't get surprises):
- Legal review lag for reseller terms (Nico to confirm 72h SLA on minor amendments).
- If image signing CI isn't green by staging freeze, we fallback to signed-by-redwood internal attestation but that may delay Marketplace acceptance.
- Named account customers may expect private deployment SKUs listed; product needs pricing guidance before listing.

Follow-up action item table (informal, note-style) — will convert to JIRA after meeting:
- Action: Finalize Azure docs copy for offer ingestion. Owner: Samir. Due: 2026-03-12. Linked: JIRA-GTM-87.
- Action: Add container-signing job to CI and enable attestation artifact upload. Owner: Eng infra (assigned: Priya M.). Due: 2026-03-17. Linked: JIRA-ENG-1432.
- Action: Update partner one-pager with marketplace-specific bullets (billing, SSO, SLAs). Owner: Ellen Wu. Due: 2026-03-11.
- Action: Legal to draft reseller addendum (minor). Owner: Nico R. Due: 2026-03-14.
- Action: Schedule joint webinar date (2-hour planning sync). Owner: Marketing (assigned: Rosa). Due: propose dates 2026-03-25 or 2026-04-01.

Personal notes on tone and asks (1:1 style):
- Be explicit: when asking for dates, propose two options (keeps momentum).
- Avoid technical deep-dives with BD folks—have eng on the call for that segment only.
- If partner pushes for earlier launch without signed artifacts, call out compliance/regulatory risk and insist on staging acceptance.

Possible conversation starters / Slack snippets to send pre-meeting:
- To AWS (Priya): "Hi Priya — quick prep for Wed: can you confirm whether AWS team expects signed artifact or will accept our internal attestation for pre-approval tests? Two quick options would be ideal. Thanks! —Samir"
- To Azure (Tomasz): "Tomasz — can you drop the CSP contact or sample payload in the meeting thread? That will help speed ingestion. Thx."

Notes I want to capture during the meeting (placeholders):
- AWS ETA:
- Azure CSP contact:
- GCP staging project id:
- Any required redwood legal clauses:
- Agreed webinar date:

Post-meeting immediate steps (first 48h):
- Convert agreed action items to JIRA tickets and tag participants (Samir).
- Send recap email with owners + due dates + links to artifacts (Ellen to review).
- Kick off image-signing CI work with eng infra and request daily 10-min stand for 3 days if needed.

Longer-term follow-ups (next 30d):
- Confirm marketplace listing live date and verify traffic routing for marketplace-originated requests.
- Run a mini smoke-test with a seeded account to measure latency and token attribution.
- Track co-marketing lead conversions from webinar (Marketing to set dashboard).

Open questions for internal prep (need answers before Wed):
- Do we have a pre-approved webinar speaker list? (Marketing)
- Are there special terms for enterprise customers purchased via marketplace (pricing parity)? (Product + Legal)
- Can we provide a staging-level billing sample that partners can test against? (Billing ops)

Misc scratch ideas (not for the meeting):
- Create a small FAQ doc for partners with common marketplace gotchas (image signing, billing token, SKU mapping). Owner: Samir.
- Consider a lightweight integration checklist in the console to speed partner onboarding.

End notes / reminders to self:
- Keep the meeting under 35m; call out when we need a deep dive and schedule another slot.
- After meeting, update this file under users/ and move final copy to shared_drives/company/partners if it's stable.

Last edited quick log:
- 2026-02-25: initial draft (outline agenda, 1st round asks).
- 2026-03-03: added ticket refs and owners after sync with Ellen.
- 2026-03-10: refined due dates and added GCP signing note after convo with Hannah.
